sections.Profile:
Rock , released by Gottlieb in October 1985, is a four-player solid-state game with a rock 'n' roll music theme, designed by John Trudeau with artwork by Larry Day. A mini-playfield with its own pair of flippers and drop targets sits at the upper left, Trudeau has described it as the first pinball machine to use a translite in place of a screened backglass, and 1,875 were built.
